propositions: The live tickets branch .bridge_state/projects.json was overwritten with rehearsal fixture keys LEG/ONE/TWO/ZERO that do not exist in live Jira, causing JQL queries like 'project = LEG AND status != Done' to fail with 'value leg does not exist for field project'.

The fetcher._build_snapshot multi-project fan-out generates one inbound query per key in projects.json; the corrupted mapping caused the first query to fail, raising an exception and aborting the entire reconcile pass.

The canonical single-project state {"version": 1, "legacy_default": "REB", "projects": {}} must be restored on origin/tickets:.bridge_state/projects.json to allow the fan-out to fall back to the default REB project.
Bridge-state writes lack unified store write-lock protection, auto-commit, and auto-push, forcing ad-hoc hand-commits that introduced the LEG/ONE/TWO/ZERO leak.
